Name: CP - Quails for Sharkles
Author: Alazdriel
Description:
[b][size=3][u][b]Jan 13, 2026 Note -
[/b][/u][/size][/b][size=3]Sorry for the lack of updates, and I am sorry to announce that I will not be providing any further support for this mod. If you are interested in picking up this mod, please feel free to do so with credits to the original. Additionally, I have received a couple of requests for additional textures/re-textures and other language support - please consider this an open invitation for anyone who wants to do those as well, and if anyone decides to continue support for this,please contact them in the future for those inquiries.[/size][b][size=3][u]

[/u][/size][/b][size=3]Again, sorry for the disappointing update, and thank you to everyone who's provided interest and support in the meantime.[/size][b][size=3][u]

[/u][/size][/b][size=3]---[/size][b][size=3][u]

Exposition:[/u][/size][/b]
After finding all existing quail mods were deprecated, I decided to make my own custom quail mod for a friend. This was a weekend project and my first ever mod for SDV. Feedback and endorsements are appreciated. Enjoy!

[b][size=3][u]This Mod Adds:[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Common Quail
[*]Valley Quail
[*]Common and Valley Quail Eggs (Normal and Large)
[*]Quail Mayonnaise (Small and Large)
[/list][b][size=3][u]Requires:[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Content Patcher (CP)
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)
[/list][u][b][size=3]Versions:[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]v1.1.0 - Latest version with best compatibility and stability.
[*]v1.0.3a - Optional hotfix of previous v1.0.3 version.
[/list][b][size=3][u]Installation:[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Vortex - Download via Vortex, install, enable, and deploy.
[*]Manual - Extract contents of mod into the Mods folder in your game files.
[/list][b][size=3][u]Uninstalling:[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Vortex - Disable and remove via Vortex.
[*]Manual - Delete [u]Quails for Sharkles[/u] from your Mods folder.
[*]For versions 1.0.3 or older - Delete the associated version named folder ([u]Standard[/u] or [u]Alternate[/u]) from your Mods folder.
[/list][b][u][size=3]Compatible Mods:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System[/url] by﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/53893506]NachOnline[/url]﻿ (Thank you!)
[/list][b][u][size=3]Related Mods:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24458]Hollowstyx's Banties and Quail[/url]﻿ for AT by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles]NoraCharles[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7046]Banties and Quail for Adopt 'n' Skin[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/13132720]Hollowstyx[/url]﻿
[/list][size=4]
[b][u][color=#ffff00]KNOWN ISSUES:[/color][/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]If you are using any version v1.0.3 or under, all of your quail assets (quails, eggs, mayo) will break in v1.1.0. I tried very hard to migrate the assets to mitigate this, but could not manage to make it work. Please see v1.0.3a if you would like to continue using that version until I figure out how to safely move the Ids over.
[/list]----
[b]
[size=3][u]Future Plans / Suggestions:[/u][/size][/b][list]
[*]migrate old v1.0.3 Ids to new v1.1.0 Ids
[*]fix villager gift tastes
[*]optional compatibility with [b]Animal Husbandry Mod[/b] ([i]in progress[/i])
[*]add quail-related recipes
[*]have quail eggs count toward Gus's Giant Omelette quest
[*]additional quail species?
[/list]
[b]Additional Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]My friends Shark and Levi for their inspiration and input regarding mod features.
[*]6480, for the much needed assistance and revisions.
[*]Elle's Cuter Barn Animals / Coop Animals used in screenshot.
[*]Everyone who's been incredibly patient with me in the mod fixing and learning process. Thank you very much for your continued support and feedback!
[/list]
